scripts.deps-wipe: rm -f pnpm-lock.yaml && rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf apps/web/node_modules && rm -rf packages/database/node_modules && rm -rf packages/database/generated
scripts.dckr-wipe: docker compose rm -v -f && docker compose down -v --remove-orphans && docker network prune -f && docker volume prune -f -a && docker container prune -f && docker image prune -a -f
scripts.reset-the-world: pnpm run deps-wipe && pnpm run dckr-wipe
